question: Subject Expert Committee (SEC) on COVID- 19, India, has recommended which of the following vaccines for phase II/III clinical trial in the age group 2 to 18 Years in May 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **Covaxin**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Covaxin is India’s indigenous Covid-19 vaccine. **__
 
• **Covaxin **is developed by **Bharat Biotech, Hyderabad** in collaboration with the** Indian Council of Medical Research’s National Institute of Virology, Pune.**
 
• In order to formulate the policy and guidelines for approval of new drugs**, clinical trials and banning of drugs an Expert Committee was constituted by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare.**
 
• **Coronavirus disease (COVID-19)** is an** infectious disease **caused by the** SARS-CoV-2 virus.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ​​**Covishield** is a recombinant, replication-deficient chimpanzee adenovirus vector encoding the SARS-CoV-2 Spike (S) glycoprotein against **COVID-19**.

 
• **​Sputnik light Vaccine **was created by** Russian scientists** based on **advanced scientific and clinical research.**
 
• **Corbevax** is a protein subunit COVID-19 vaccine developed by** Texas Children's Hospital Center for Vaccine Development **and **Baylor College of Medicine in Houston, Texas and Dynavax technologies **based in** Emeryville, California.**
